service.description: The pay runs of the employers in the caller's payroll scope (PAYROLL_VIEW), newest period first, filtered by employer, group and state (cancelled ones left out unless asked): each its group, period, pay date, kind, worker count, excluded, error and pending counts, the gross and net of its calculated employments, and its state. show attention: the runs that need payroll's work (an employee in error, pending while calculating, returned by the approver, or an approval that no longer holds). Refuses a caller without PAYROLL_VIEW (PERMISSION_DENIED).

service.description: A run of a pay group in the caller's payroll scope for one of its prepared periods (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT): the group's employer and currency, the period's pay date unless another is given, an optional source cutoff and description. A regular run (the default) selects its population at once (the employments the group pays on a day of the period, each pending), one live a group and period. An off-cycle run (P26; any number a period, any pay date) pays the period's approved adjustments no run took: its population is the employments that have them (or those of partyRelationshipIds), with no salary or structure line. Refuses: another employer's group (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a period not prepared for it (PERIOD_UNAVAILABLE), an ended group (GROUP_ENDED), a correction (KIND_NOT_AVAILABLE: made from its slip, create#Correction), a regular run of a period whose inputs a live regular run took (INPUTS_CONSUMED) or with a live regular run already (RUN_EXISTS), an off-cycle run with no adjustment to pay (NOTHING_TO_PAY). An operation key answers a retry with the first run.

parameter.name: partyRelationshipIds
parameter.description: An off-cycle run's employments (those with an adjustment to pay when empty)

service.description: A run's population (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT): brought in step with the group (an employment the group now pays joins pending, one it no longer pays leaves), employments excluded with a reason (excludeIds, exclusionReason: REASON_REQUIRED; kept in the run and the approval, out of its totals) or included again (includeIds), and the pay date changed. Each change is reviewed again: an approval no longer holds and a request waiting is superseded. Refuses a run finalizing, finalized or cancelled (RUN_CLOSED), an approved run whose slip a correction corrects (RUN_CORRECTED, P26 review) and an employment not in the run (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A run's pending and failed employments calculated, and those whose sources changed since they were calculated (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT), each in its own transaction under the employment's lock: one that fails is left in error with its reason code and message (SALARY_MISSING, RATE_MISSING, NO_ASSIGNMENT, NO_SCHEDULE, MISSING_INPUT, CYCLIC_DEPENDENCY, CURRENCY_MISMATCH, NEGATIVE_NET and the like) while the others are calculated. Bounded: at most batchSize a call (100 by default, 500 at most), stopping after a minute; the rest stay pending and a later call resumes them. A calculated employment whose sources are as they were is not calculated again, so a repeated call makes no second result. The calculation (PayrollRuns.js): the period split where the assignment, salary or pay rates change, each segment prorated by the group's policy and computed from the structure's published terms, the lines summed or taken once, adjustments added, each money line rounded to the currency, the localization once, net and employer cost. The inputs a calculation takes are marked with the run. No invoice or payment is made. The run is in review once nothing is pending. P26: an off-cycle run's employment pays its adjustments alone (NOTHING_TO_PAY when none is left); a correction run's pays the change from what its original slip and the corrections before it paid (NO_CHANGE when nothing changed, ORIGINAL_WITHDRAWN when the original was withdrawn); an approved run with nothing to calculate keeps its approval and slips, and one whose slip a correction corrects is not recalculated (RUN_CORRECTED).

A run as PayRunDetail shows it (PAYROLL_VIEW): its header (group, period, pay date, kind, state, the group's readiness), the progress counts (pending, calculated, error, excluded, changed since calculated) and percent, the totals of the calculated employments, the approval (state, who decides, decisions) and whether an approval still holds, the steps done, what the caller may do, the population (paged, by state and name) with each employment's totals, variance from the group's previous run and reason; with partyRelationshipId, that employment's result lines with their explanations, how its period was split and the inputs it took. Refuses another employer's run (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

Approval asked of a run in review (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT; NOT_IN_REVIEW otherwise): a People approval of kind PakPayrollRun at the run's revision (its population, amounts and source fingerprints), sent to the employer's payroll approvers unless a rule says otherwise, never one who selected or calculated it. Refuses a run with an employee pending (CALCULATION_INCOMPLETE) or in error (UNITS_UNRESOLVED: fix and calculate again, or exclude with a reason), none calculated (NOTHING_CALCULATED), results whose sources changed since (SOURCE_CHANGED), or a request waiting at this revision (APPROVAL_PENDING).

A correction of a payslip (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT; impl-people P26, design §8.2): a run of its own, kind correction, for the slip's group, period and employment, with the reason (the changed source or rule) and a pay date (the original's when empty: a slip of the same day keeps its own identity). A correction of a correction corrects its original. It is calculated (the employment as it is now, less what the original and the corrections before it paid), asked, approved and slipped as any run; its slip names the original, which stays as it was. Refuses a slip outside the payroll scope (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE), a withdrawn original (SLIP_WITHDRAWN), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED), a correction of the slip already open (CORRECTION_EXISTS) and an employment the group no longer pays in the period (NOT_IN_GROUP), unless the employment ended by the period's last day (P27, the user's call of Nov 12, 2026: a backdated separation is corrected to what it pays now, nothing before the leaving day, and the overpayment recovered at finalization). An operation key answers a retry with the first run. A correction of an off-cycle slip recalculates its adjustments alone. Once a correction (not cancelled) corrects a slip, the slip's run keeps its approval: calculating it with work to do or selecting it is refused (RUN_CORRECTED), so the original never changes. No invoice or payment is made.

A run not approved cancelled with the reason (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT; impl-people P25 review): a draft, calculating or in review, a request waiting for its approval superseded. The inputs its calculation took are released and its regular key freed, so the group's period may be run again; its population and draft results stay, read as a cancelled run's. Refuses an approved, finalizing or finalized run (RUN_NOT_CANCELLABLE: an approved one is returned or calculated again first), no reason (REASON_REQUIRED) and another employer's run (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). A repeat answers the cancellation. No invoice or payment is made or undone.

The approver's approval of a run (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_APPROVE; also the PayrollRunApproval topic's approve service, which approve#NotificationMessage calls as the user with the record and message), at the revision read (the notice's sourceRevision): through PeopleApprovalServices.record#Decision, the last approval approves the run at that revision. Refuses who selected, calculated or asked (SELF_APPROVAL), anyone not the step's approver (NOT_APPROVER), a run changed since the request (SOURCE_CHANGED), a notice of another record (SOURCE_INVALID) and another employer's run (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE). P26: the approval makes the run's calculated employments payslips (preview slips in preview mode), and nobody whose own pay the run holds decides it (SELF_APPROVAL). No invoice or payment is made.

An approved run of a live pay group finalized (PAYROLL_VIEW and PAYROLL_EDIT), under locks: the approval still holding (APPROVAL_NO_LONGER_HOLDS) and every amount's account mapped (ACCOUNT_MAPPING_MISSING) first; then each employment in its own transaction: its slip made final, the inputs its calculation took finalized, its net pay a draft invoice from the person through Mantle's invoice services (earnings on their expense accounts, deductions and the localization's employee amount withheld on their liability accounts; a reimbursement left out), each expense claim it reimburses linked as it is (no second expense), an overpayment (a negative correction) to recover by deductions on the next regular runs or, once the person has left, as a receivable; one that fails is left pending with its reason while the others go on. Once every employment is final, the localization payee's amounts as one invoice from the group's payee, then the run's invoices released to Accounting (received) and the run finalized; until then nothing is released. A retry finds what was made (each obligation's unique key) and finishes the rest; a finalized run answers as it is (repeated). No ledger entry, approval for payment or payment is made here. Refuses a run not approved (NOT_APPROVED), a pay group that is not live (NOT_LIVE, naming each reason: every group of this build, the demonstration localization never being live), and another employer's run (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

A run's settlement as payroll reads it (PAYROLL_VIEW): each obligation (net pay, a payee's amounts, an expense claim settled, a receivable) with its invoice, the invoice's state and posting, what is unpaid and the payments applied with their states (a returned payment shown as such: Accounting's, never a second payment status); for each person the wage net, the reimbursement still due on their claims and the total payment instruction; the overpayments to recover with what is recovered and what remains; and why a finalization is still pending. Refuses another employer's run (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).

service.description: An invoice a pay run's obligation names (one its finalization made: net pay, a payee's amounts, a receivable; or an expense claim it settled), as payroll reads it on People's InvoiceDetail (PAYROLL_VIEW at the employer): the obligation (kind, run, slip, person, payee, amount), the invoice's header, state and posting, its lines with their accounts and the payments applied. Read and reconcile only. Refuses an invoice no obligation names or another employer's (RECORD_UNAVAILABLE).
